name: ContextAvatar
description:
A context's avatar: its logo, its icon or its initials on its tint. A rounded square, so
an organisation or project never reads as a person (people are round, ui/avatar). The
"all" scope is a glyph on a neutral tile.
signature: ({ item, size, decorative, icon, allLabel: allLabelProp, className, ...rest }: ContextAvatarProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: allLabel
props.description: The accessible name for the "all" scope when not decorative (default "All organisations").

props.name: decorative
props.description: Hidden from assistive tech (default): a visible name sits beside it.

props.name: icon
props.description: The glyph for the "all" scope (default the organisation glyph).

props.name: item
props.description: The context, or null for the "all" scope.

props.name: size
props.description: xs 20 (lists, chips) · sm 24 (top bar, dock) · md 32 · lg 40 (page headers).

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
